title: ISO IEC 11179 Metadata Registries
summary: ISO/IEC 11179 — a multi-part international standard for metadata registries, describing how to register, define, name and identify data elements and related concepts.
body_markdown:
# ISO IEC 11179 Metadata Registries

## Scope

Metadata registries: the metamodel for registering data element concepts, value domains and data elements, and guidance on definitions, naming and identification.

## Requirements

Includes guidance for formulating data definitions (e.g. state what the concept is, not only what it is not) and for naming conventions. Details to be taken from the standard text.

## Applicability

Metadata repository design ([[Metadata Management Reference Architecture]]), definition quality, naming standards.
